Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
"If a member of the owning clan controlled by the Gargoyle's controller is
blocked, the controller can tap the slave Gargoyle to cancel the combat and
untap the acting vampire and have the slave Gargoyle enter combat with the
blocking minion instead."

Who is the acting minion in this instance, the untapped vampire or the
tapped Gargoyle who is now entering combat?

Roger

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <9s125a$1035ea$1...@ID-104455.news.dfncis.de>, Roger Carhult


The acting vampire, since nothing has altered that.

See also Malleable Visage, IIRC.

This confused me a bit, but then I went and read the card: "Only usable
when this reacting vampire is about to enter combat with an acting younger
vampire."
Koo. A way to enter combat with during your turn without acting. That
IS quite deadly, and a sicko surprise for Lucian trying to block Sarah
Cobbler. =)
Ah, that pesky card text. =)
